WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.channel_code, f.etl_loaded_at, p.sku, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
)
SELECT count(*) n_lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d_lines, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d_rl, sum(quantity) units, sum(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN quantity END) test_units,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE quantity<=0) nonpos, count(*) FILTER (WHERE staff_purchase_flag) staff_lines, count(DISTINCT channel_code) ch, min(etl_loaded_at) mn, max(etl_loaded_at) mx, count(DISTINCT sku) skus
FROM sold

calls.statement:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT p.sku, f.quantity, f.staff_purchase_flag
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
), ret AS (
  SELECT p.sku, r.quantity_returned
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=102 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
), u AS (SELECT sku, sum(quantity) units, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) staff_units, count(*) lines FROM sold GROUP BY sku),
 rr AS (SELECT sku, sum(quantity_returned) ret_units FROM ret GROUP BY sku)
SELECT u.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, u.units, u.staff_units, u.lines, COALESCE(rr.ret_units,0) ret_units, u.units-COALESCE(rr.ret_units,0) net_units,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_product x WHERE x.sku=u.sku) versions
FROM u JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=u.sku AND cp.is_current LEFT JOIN rr ON rr.sku=u.sku
ORDER BY u.units DESC LIMIT 10

WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date d, sum(f.net_amount) gross_net, sum(f.quantity) units, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT business_date d, receipts, units_sold, net_sales_before_returns nsb FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27')
SELECT count(*) days, sum(CASE WHEN l.units=r.units_sold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) units_match, sum(l.units) lu, sum(r.units_sold) ru, sum(l.gross_net) ln, sum(r.nsb) rn, sum(CASE WHEN l.rc=r.receipts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) rc_match,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.d IS NULL) only_r, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.d IS NULL) only_l
FROM l FULL JOIN r ON l.d=r.d

calls.statement:
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id = 102
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY cp.sku, cp.product_name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3
